data.text: I’m in. I commit to choosing 15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, with the receipt shared here. That completes our four pledges for today’s $60,000 payment. I’ll take 6 tons next month as agreed, then 10 tons once the lake returns to 100. My family’s livelihood depends on this lake, and our neighbors depend on the clinic—let’s honor both commitments.
